extra.reason: Fixed: boot-probe.js no longer stamps document.title on success — the packaged window title is the product's ('Spruce Grove', verified live in the rebuilt .app via System Events). boot:ERROR/boot:REJECTION (and a new boot:CSP breadcrumb for policy violations) still speak on failure; successful boot progress stays in the sg-boot-* marker files.

Fixed: steer and cancel now leave persistent .msg.steer transcript markers (addInterruption) — 'steer · queued' carries the redirect text, 'canceled' records the stop. The .msg.steer ember styling existed in both stylesheets but was never wired; now it is. UI suite asserts both markers.

Fixed: aria-labels on all icon-only controls (sidebar-toggle/open, insp-refresh/close, picker up/close, persona radio/name/remove/dirs, cwd, cancel, prompt); #status is role=status aria-live=polite; transcript is role=log with live off (no token-stream flooding); inspector tabs are a real tablist/tab/tabpanel with arrow-key walking and aria-selected; settings dialog moves focus in on open and restores the invoker on close; picker restores invoker focus; inspector toggle carries aria-pressed. All asserted in UI suite section 15.

Fixed: .field is shrinkable at every width (flex 0 1 auto, min-width 0, input flexes with max-width 380px instead of the unshrinkable min(380px,42vw)) — the negative-x topbar bleed over the sidebar is structurally gone (topbar also clips). Below 720px the topbar wraps and the cwd field takes its own full row; below 560px buttons go icon-only. The empty state clamps to min(720px,100%) so the paths row cannot drive it past the viewport. UI suite section 16 proves at 500x700: no horizontal overflow, browse/send/sidebar-toggle all hit-testable.

Fixed: all five families self-hosted — 11 woff2 files in ui/fonts/ (variable-weight ranges: Fraunces 400-600 incl. opsz, Inter 400-600, JetBrains Mono 400-600, EB Garamond 400-500 normal+italic, IM Fell 400; latin + latin-ext), ui/fonts.css with real @font-face rules, Google links removed from ui/index.html and all three handoff decks (handoff/fonts.css + handoff/fonts/). Zero network at runtime; CSP-clean; offline cannot degrade the transcript's type mid-stream. tools/vendor-fonts.py re-vendors reproducibly (652KB per side).

Fixed all three: (1) startAcp no longer stamps a 'new session' row — row creation now requires an explicit create flag, passed only by newChat; boot auto-start, dir switches, resumes and self-heals touch no rows, and sendPrompt records the session with its real first prompt. (2) startAcp clears activeSessionId and re-renders up front, so slow/failed starts cannot leave a stale ember highlight; the old pre-sets in openSession/newChat are gone. (3) session rows are role=button divs (aria-label, tabindex, Enter/Space activation, aria-current) so the destructive × is a real button, not a button nested in a button.

Verified: npm run icon regenerates the full Sevardhet v6 set from assets/source-icon.png — every raster is byte-identical to the committed set (same source), and the icns was refreshed (container bytes differ, content identical). Rebuilt the .app: bundle Resources/icon.icns md5 matches the repo icns; mic plist grant intact; v0.1.0. Added icons/icon.ico to bundle.icon so Windows builds bundle it (it existed but was never listed). Launched the packaged app: window title clean ('Spruce Grove'), boot markers dropped (mainjs-loaded, listen-ok, bridge-probe acked), then quit cleanly. Windows/Linux tiles verified at the artifact level (CI ships the sets); on-machine smoke stays a human download per TEST-MAP.

Fixed: qa-kitten SKILL.md gained an 'Evidence Transport Constraint (this rig)' section — (1) never upload screenshot media to the model (files.synthetic.new times out with ModelHTTPError 400 and kills the run; evidence must travel as DOM text: snapshots, computed styles, bounding boxes), (2) never report from truncated instructions — stop and say so instead of hallucinating content (the deck-report incident). Updated the canonical plugin source (SPRUCE-GROVE-OS venv code_puppy_core_plugins/qa_kitten_skill) AND the deployed copy in ~/.code_puppy/plugin-skills/; both md5-verified identical.

Fixed in the MOCK (tests/test_desktop_ui.py), mirroring the real backend: grove_acp_cancel now stops the fake stream dead — all pending stream timers are cleared, a turn token guards against stragglers, and an orderly turn-end with stopReason 'cancelled' arrives 20ms later (long-tail turns ≥3 give cancel a real window instead of racing a 200ms end_turn). grove_acp_start with resume now emits a session/load replay as ordinary agent_message_chunk events, asserted in the UI suite. The mock is single-source for both the suite and tests/mock_server.py.

Fixed in the same sweep: CSP widened to default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' — verified embedded in the rebuilt bundle binary. Guard: the UI harness now serves every response under the packaged CSP, so the look-in data-URL assertion (and everything else) runs under the real policy from now on.
